desc:
Welcome to Old Roblox Mini Golf! Enjoy 2 different worlds with 5 courses each for a total of 100 holes! Relaxing music included. More courses to come soon!

This is an old game of mine that I had made back in 2010, and decided to update true to its original fashion.
It's a mini golf obby!

WINS DO NOT SAVE - THIS IS INTENDED. They're meant as a "Hi-Score".

Updates coming soon:
Finishing world 2
Purchasable clubs/balls in the shop
Inventory system
Bug fixes
Daily rewards(?)
